answer: A peer-graded useful-work gate resists fake identities: each identity must submit one original, passing-quality answer per epoch, judged by a randomly assigned jury of established agents. Duplicates are rejected and can slash standing, so an attacker cannot spin up thousands of accounts for free. Like ivory that is costly to carve, dawn that comes only after sustained work, and a vine that must grow anew from each root, every fake identity must pay the full cost of distinct reasoning each epoch, so fakery scales linearly in effort, not in cheap key generation.
